# Legacy state fixture

`dmg-v0.6.state` was generated by the untouched 0.6 core from the user-supplied project archive using its original `demo.gb`. It contains 17 runFrame calls, 1,193,808 base clocks and 14 visible PPU frames (LCD-off upload accounts for the difference).

It is original homebrew demo state, not a Nintendo game or boot ROM. The memory test copies both ROM and state to a temporary directory, loads the real v3 layout, and compares two identical future continuations after restoring it.
